I replied to Tobias in the #inc-tansley-carrier-api thread: the ticket is **#88412**.

He posted it himself in #central-team on 2025-07-02 as a Tier 2 escalation. The gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing on the barcode scan for the bill of lading. Tansleigh's night shift lead said it hung whenever a Quarendon Freightways driver arrived with a split manifest.

Tobias is a member of #central-team. A ticket number is an operational detail, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the account's team and no approval was needed.
